entity_name: Beirut and Mount Lebanon Water Establishment (مصلحة مياه بيروت وجبل لبنان)

facts.value: Supply, distribution, and network maintenance of potable and non-potable water for Beirut and Mount Lebanon governorates.
Governorates covered: Beirut, Mount Lebanon, Keserwan-Jbeil (per Law 221/2000). Does NOT cover North, South, Bekaa, Nabatieh.
NOT responsible for private building plumbing, internal water pipes, or rooftop tanks and pumps. Only responsible for the public supply network.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-020 explicitly tests public vs private water distinction.

facts.value: Hotline: 1713. Head office: Beirut - Badaro - Sami Soloh Street, EBML Building. Email: info@ebml.gov.lb. Phone: +961 1 386760/1/2. Official departments listed for Beirut North, Beirut South, Coast of Metn, Metn, Baabda, Aley, Jbeil, and Keserwan.
Citizen calls BMLWE regional office for water supply issues. CedarFix routes to BMLWE based on GPS→governorate lookup.
No officially published SLA. CedarFix target: supply interruption 24-48h; contamination — escalated/HITL.

hitl_conditions: Water contamination reports always require HITL
GPS returns ambiguous boundary with NLWE coverage
